title: The General Matrix cannot be deleted
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open the General Matrix's three-dot menu.
  3. Point at Delete.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The General Matrix is listed with the Default badge.

Step 2:

  • The menu shows Duplicate and a disabled Delete.

Step 3:

  • A tooltip reads "The General Matrix can't be deleted. You can edit it."
